body.title: Implement bounded canonical source identity
body.summary: Implement proposed src/workflow/usage/canonical.ts for strict safe-data traversal, canonical source bytes and the usage-specific digest. Ignore only service-assigned sequence/recordedAt/digest; keep capture owner and all typed source payload in identity.
acceptanceChecks: Reordered object keys produce equal identity; changed source payload/owner is different; changing only service metadata does not create another source event.

Object inputs use one central usage-domain safe snapshot/serialization boundary; getters/toJSON/custom prototypes/cycles/sparse arrays/symbols/undefined/invalid Unicode and unsafe values are rejected without invoking hooks. Traversal, retained bookkeeping and output are bounded; initial JavaScript own-key enumeration allocation is excluded. Oversized arrays are rejected before key enumeration.
16 KiB/depth/node limits and the exact domain-separated SHA-256 format are enforced; existing lifecycle/design-corpus canonicalizers remain unchanged.

tests.name: src/workflow/usage/__tests__/identity.test.ts: source equality versus server metadata, owner/payload conflicts, canonical key order and unsafe getter/prototype/cycle/Unicode/limit inputs
